conditions: 16.0 Mbit/s shared, 100 ms TTFB, in-process loopback

feed_preview_ttff_ms.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; feed card lease to first rendered frame, median of 4 simultaneous cards

viewer_ttff_from_feed_ms.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; Viewer lease to first frame for a clip a feed card was playing

viewer_time_to_playing_from_feed_ms.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; Viewer lease to isPlaying for that clip

viewer_rebuffer_count.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; rebuffers while the clip loops twice in the Viewer

viewer_rebuffer_ms.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; time spent rebuffering while the clip loops twice

clip_bytes_per_view_mb.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; bytes served for the clip: feed autoplay plus two Viewer loops (file 7.3 MB)

clip_duplicate_mb.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; bytes of that clip served more than once (re-downloaded ranges)

feed_bytes_after_viewer_open_mb.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; bytes the other three feed clips kept downloading after the Viewer opened

viewer_ttff_cold_ms.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; Viewer lease to first frame for a 90 s video nothing had loaded

seek_to_resume_ms.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; seek past the buffer to playing again, median of 4 seeks

seek_to_resume_max_ms.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; slowest of those 4 seeks

scrub_first_frame_ms.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; scrub preview opened to its first frame, past the buffer

scrub_frame_ms.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; scrub preview frame past the buffer, median of 3 targets

scrub_bytes_mb.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; bytes downloaded to show those 3 preview frames

seek_after_scrub_ms.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; release seek to the last previewed position until playing

long_bytes_mb.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; bytes served for the 90 s video over the seek and scrub session

long_duplicate_mb.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; bytes of the 90 s video served more than once

gallery_open_to_first_page_ms.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; Viewer session start to page 1 decoded at screen size

page_load_p50_ms.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; page becomes current to decoded, median while reading 40 pages at 1.2 s each

page_load_p90_ms.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; 90th percentile of the same

pages_ready_ahead.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; of the next 10 pages, how many are on disk when a page opens (higher is better)

skim_shown_pct.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; pages shown within 200 ms while skimming 35 pages (higher is better)

skim_shown_p50_ms.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; median time to show the skimmed pages that made it

peak_memory_delta_mb.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; peak Java plus native heap growth while paging

peak_memory_mb.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; peak Java plus native heap while paging

gallery_bytes_mb.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; bytes served for gallery pages over the session

gallery_duplicate_mb.method: interleaved run by run with round 1 head; median of 3 runs; gallery page bytes served more than once

notes: Baseline code (benchmark harness only). Measured interleaved run by run with round 1 in the same session: video scenarios in build/media-bench/round1-ab, gallery in build/media-bench/gallery-abc. A first standalone baseline session (same commit) gave the same picture but drifted up to 90 ms on seeks as the phone warmed, which is why rounds are compared interleaved.
